facts.fact: The EUISS brief describes Kenya's national strategy as focused on connectivity, digital public services, entrepreneurship and data-driven growth, citing the Kenya National Digital Master Plan 2022-2032 published by the Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, Nairobi, 2022.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy

note: Brief also notes a March 2026 EU-Kenya Digital Dialogue (cooperation event, not a strategy fact). No adoption act or reporting stated.
